provenance.descriptorKind: derived v0.18.4 declaration compatibility descriptors, not original execution manifests
limitations: Original screen.json, stage run.json, archived INI files, runtime receipts and native-preflight proofs were not supplied. Derived descriptors check recorded declaration compatibility; they are not recovered original manifests.

Recorded profile/registry hashes, starting armies, openings, strengths, search settings and applied value policies match the reconstructed declarations. Engine names and profile hashes do not attest the executable or its native tables.
Moves and terminal outcomes were not independently replayed. No new matches, engine searches, outcome-fitted material values or individual-piece Elo were produced.
All studies use sixteen related fixed opening cases. Opening-block ranges are conditional; raw game counts do not imply that many independent starting positions.

report.name: Version 18 level1-followup reference screen: batch 1, 40000 nodes
report.question: Compare five stronger L1 revisions with three fresh matched body controls against the fixed L1 reference basket. Native minor pairs and queen singles retain separate equal purchase budgets.

overall.method: Equal opponent means over shared fully completed opening cases; every configured repetition requires a complete color pair. Draws count half a point.

matrix.perspective: row army score against column army; draws count half

notes: Scores use complete color-swapped pairs only, with equal weight for each represented opening prefix. Draws count half a point.
Unpaired completions, move-limit truncations, errors and cancelled games do not become draws or losses.
16 fixed short prefixes are a coarse descriptive screen, not independent samples supporting a precise strength estimate. No material values or individual piece Elo are fitted.
This report validates journal identities and summarizes recorded outcomes; it does not independently replay every move.

evaluationAudit.policy: All knight controls and revisions use the established 1203/1352 MG/EG pair. The Bishop-pawn control and both new board-pawn revisions instead share the selected Quiet-tall Knight-pawn prior 536/592. This deliberately replaces the old Bishop-pawn 214/245 prior only in this new follow-up; its old screen percentage is not pooled with the fresh new-prior control. The three L2 references, including the F reserve grant, retain their frozen priors. Every pair is applied to all six engine tables for both colors. No material values are fitted.
